description: Browse the demand-side entity catalog — every service, tool and standard companies are measured against, ranked by how many carry it. Free. This is the left-hand side of the inversion: pick an entity here, then call entity_demand to see WHO.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

min_companies.description: Only entities carried by at least this many companies.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use with `limit` to walk a long list.

q.description: Substring match on the entity name.

name: find_entities
